title: International Foundation Diploma In Business Studies (Level 3)
description: Enhance your business acumen and leadership skills with the Endorsed Diploma in Business Studies (Level 3).
longDescription: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of core business principles, including Introduction to Research and Academic Skills, Using IT for Business,Introduction to Economics and Accounting, and Introduction to the Business Environment. Students will develop essential skills in decision-making, financial analysis, and organizational behaviour to prepare for various business challenges. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 60 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: The Endorsed Diploma in Business studies (Level 3) covers fundamental concepts of business, including Introduction to Research and Academic Skills. Using IT for Business,Introduction to Economics and Accounting,and Introduction to the Business Environment. It explores how businesses function, make decisions, and interact with the external environment. Students learn about strategies for achieving business goals, managing resources, and understanding global business challenges.

entry: Endorsed Diploma In Business Studies (Level-3), learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: Upon completing the Endorsed Diploma In Business Studies (Level-3) students become eligible to pursue advanced studies, including admission into a master's degree. This qualification opens doors to various programs, allowing students to specialize further in areas such as business administration, finance, or marketing.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
